Cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) MATCH (b:Entity {id: f.beneficiary_bank_id})-[:COUNTRY]->(country:Country) WHERE f.beneficiary_iso = country.code WITH country.code AS country_code, avg(f.amount) AS avg_amount ORDER BY avg_amount DESC RETURN country_code, avg_amount LIMIT 1

Question: Find the movie with the highest difference in the number of votes between any two movies the same actor has worked on.
Cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) WHERE m1 <> m2 WITH m1, m2, abs(m1.votes - m2.votes) AS vote_diff WITH max(vote_diff) AS max_vote_diff MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) WHERE m1 <> m2 AND abs(m1.votes - m2.votes) = max_vote_diff RETURN m1.title, m2.title, max_vote_diff

MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)
WITH p, m, r.roles AS roles, m.released AS released
WITH p, min(released) AS first_release
WITH p, first_release, p.born AS born
WHERE first_release IS NOT NULL AND born IS NOT NULL
RETURN avg(first_release - born) AS avg_years_between_birth_and_first_role
